review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() confirmed USDT and EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero, making the MetaMorpho vault immutable. The owner chain resolves on-chain to the 5-of-10 Steakhouse Safe, whose parameter control cannot mint shares outside the deposit flow. Durable mint authority remains inherited from reviewed USDT; no wrapper-specific reserve reconciliation or prudential supervisor is established.
